PRE-NORM: input_layernorm before attention and post_attention_layernorm before the MLP; sublayer outputs are added to the residual stream directly (no norm on the outputs). Weights (bf16, safetensors, read-only): /workspace/model/model.safetensors-00001-of-00001.safetensors. A linear module computes y = W x with W of shape (d_out, d_in).

writable modules: for each layer i = 0..23, mlp.down_proj (1024 x 3584) and the attention output projection: model.layers.{i}.self_attn.o_proj for i in {3,7,11,15,19,23}, model.layers.{i}.linear_attn.out_proj otherwise (both 1024 x 2048). import numpy as np, json, struct
PATH='/workspace/model/model.safetensors-00001-of-00001.safetensors'
_hdr=None
def header():
    global _hdr
    if _hdr is None:
        with open(PATH,'rb') as fh:
            n=struct.unpack('<Q',fh.read(8))[0]
            _hdr=json.loads(fh.read(n))
    return _hdr
def load(key, dtype=np.float32):
    h=header()
    info=h[key]
    off=8+struct.unpack('<Q',open(PATH,'rb').read(8))[0]+info['data_offsets'][0]
    ln=info['data_offsets'][1]-info['data_offsets'][0]
    with open(PATH,'rb') as fh:
        fh.seek(off); raw=fh.read(ln)
    if info['dtype']=='BF16':
        a=np.frombuffer(raw,dtype=np.uint16).astype(np.uint32)<<16
        a=a.view(np.float32).astype(dtype)
    elif info['dtype']=='F32':
        a=np.frombuffer(raw,dtype=np.float32).astype(dtype)
    else:
        raise ValueError(info['dtype'])
    return a.reshape(info['shape'])
def keys():
    return list(header().keys())
EOF
